snippet.title: Sonic Re-Imagined: Showcase 2 (v3.2)
snippet.description:
Welcome to the showcase for Sonic Re-Imagined v3.2! This update fixes some, breaks some, adds some and removes some.
For this video, I tried going with a different style, so let me know what you think! Also, excuse me for the delay, and forgive me for the garbage footage.
This showcase doesn’t show it, but v3.2 includes slotting features (it wasn’t originally going to, but I decided to delay it a little). I finally figured out how to use the CSK Collection to slot everything properly! Going forward, updates shouldn’t take long gaps anymore and will focus on bug fixes and little additions.

Get it here! Sonic Re-Imagined (https://gamebanana.com/mods/443018)

Some changes were made after this video's making. So here is a quick list of changes (that will be updated the more I remember):
1. Sonic's boosting startup animation was changed to base of his animation from Sonic Advance 2 when starting a level.
2. Move images are fully updated!
3. Sonic's up smash works slightly differently, it knocks foes down instead of letting them fall.
4. Boost's strength is dependent on Boost meter.
5. Sonic's instashield barrier only works once when in the air. You can still perform the move again.
6. You can homing attack two times now. Holding the button thing may or may not be included in final.
7. SpinDash cancel always bring Sonic to a skidding animation to avoid issues found during development for now.
8. Stomp’s descent is faster if you hold the attack button down.
9. Sonic does a breakdance during down tilt’s end. Will be included in extras.

Other mods shown in the video by:

mayamia (shoutouts!) https://x.com/SoloNoodles
An HDR Styled UI [by mayamia and JoBen]
Cinematic Final Smash
(not sure if im allowed to share it here, but there's an archive of her mods in a MEGA link. Look for "Project M CSS" in gamebanana).

& nanobuds for the Knux model (https://gamebanana.com/members/2034177)
